resources.string: Shows a floating button that locks the screen when tapped. The service does not read screen content or anything you type.
Android only lets accessibility services lock the screen. Open Accessibility settings, choose %1$s and turn it on.
If the switch is greyed out, open this app\'s App info, tap the ⋮ menu and choose \"Allow restricted settings\".
Hold the button for 5 seconds to open this app. Drag it to the bottom of the screen to hide it; open this app to bring it back.
Tap the button again during the delay to cancel.
Pin to left or right edge

Some banking apps will not open while this app\'s accessibility service is on. Add the %1$s tile to Quick Settings, tap it to turn the service off before using the banking app, then tap it again afterwards.
Ready: the tile turns the service on and off.
One-time setup: turn on USB debugging, connect this phone to a computer and run the command below. You can turn USB debugging off afterwards. Until then, the tile opens this app.
